claims.claim_text_verbatim: This enables agents to learn and evolve capabilities through their own experiences without parameter updates.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam enables LLM agents to learn and evolve without parameter updates

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Evaluations show that Hippocam achieves strong performance across memory, knowledge use, and learning.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam achieves strong performance across memory, knowledge use, and learning tasks

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Whereas competing methods show more uneven performance across these demands, Hippocam leads or matches the best compared method on seven of the eight measures in Fig. 1.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam leads or matches the top baseline on seven of eight measures

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Hippocam does not build a memory bank separate from its interaction history, but remembers and learns by deliberately maintaining its context.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam remembers and learns by maintaining context rather than a separate memory bank

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Both forms of consolidation keep the agent’s recent context focused and high-signal, enabling accurate and coherent reasoning over long horizons.
claims.claim_summary: Consolidation keeps context high-signal, enabling accurate long-horizon reasoning

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Experience that remains unused continues to recede in detail through recursive consolidation, without separately assigned importance scores or time-based forgetting rules.
claims.claim_summary: Unused experience recedes in detail recursively without explicit importance scores or decay rules

claims.claim_text_verbatim: This natural dynamic of use and disuse unifies the recovery of past experience with learning that deepens what the agent knows, refines how it acts, and expands what it can accomplish.
claims.claim_summary: Use and disuse dynamic unifies memory recovery and capability development

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Hippocam improves across all three benchmarks, achieving 97.8% ALFWorld success and tying ACE for the best result.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam achieves 97.8% ALFWorld success rate, tying ACE for best performance

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Its 81.9% mean ScienceWorld progress exceeds four of the six compared methods.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam reaches 81.9% mean progress on ScienceWorld, outperforming four of six baselines

claims.claim_text_verbatim: On StreamBench, it achieves the highest mean accuracy of 81.7%, narrowly ahead of Letta’s 81.3%.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam leads StreamBench with 81.7% mean accuracy

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In both streams, Hippocam also achieves higher accuracy with about 10% lower average cost per task in the later 150-task interval (§ A.9).
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam increases accuracy while lowering per-task cost by 10% in later tasks

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Hippocam achieves 78.9% mean progress, improving over Plain by 30.1 pp and exceeding the strongest baseline, ACE, by 16.2 pp.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam hits 78.9% ScienceWorld progress, exceeding ACE by 16.2 percentage points

claims.claim_text_verbatim: On FEVER, Frozen scores cluster around Plain’s 59.3%, with Hippocam and HiAgent reaching 61.8%.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam and HiAgent reach 61.8% accuracy on FEVER under frozen transfer

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Only Hippocam and ACE achieve positive gains on both domain transitions, while the remaining methods show mixed, unchanged, or reduced performance.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam and ACE are the only methods with positive transfer gains across both transitions

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Hippocam achieves larger gains of 19.2 and 6.0 pp, respectively, with a narrower FEVER gap under the scoring sensitivity analysis (§ A.2).
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam achieves 19.2 pp and 6.0 pp domain transfer gains on target benchmarks

claims.claim_text_verbatim: In contrast, Hippocam maintains high performance in both conditions without degradation under interleaving, scoring 85.1% in isolation and 88.7% under interleaving (Fig. 5, left).
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam resists degradation under task interleaving, scoring 85.1% isolated and 88.7% interleaved

claims.claim_text_verbatim: On LoCoMo, Hippocam achieves 77.6% overall accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline, A-Mem, by 10.1 pp (Table 3).
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam achieves 77.6% overall accuracy on LoCoMo, beating A-Mem by 10.1 pp

claims.claim_text_verbatim: It leads or ties across all four answerable question categories, with temporal accuracy reaching 86.6% compared with A-Mem’s 67.6%.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam leads or ties all answerable LoCoMo categories, hitting 86.6% temporal accuracy

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Hippocam combines stronger conversational reasoning with 87.2% accuracy on unanswerable questions.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam maintains 87.2% accuracy on unanswerable adversarial questions

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Across the three input lengths, Hippocam achieves 71.7% mean accuracy, compared with 44.3% for Letta (Fig. 5, right).
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam averages 71.7% accuracy across input lengths on MemoryAgentBench

claims.claim_text_verbatim: It matches HiAgent at 97.0% on 6k inputs and retains 77.0% and 41.0% accuracy at 32k and 64k, where no baseline exceeds 37.0% and 19.0%, respectively.
claims.claim_summary: Hippocam maintains 77% and 41% accuracy at 32k and 64k inputs on MemoryAgentBench

claims.claim_text_verbatim: On GoodAI, filler retention rises from 14% to 63%, while scores fall by 23.1 pp under interleaving versus 7.3 pp in isolation (Table 4).
claims.claim_summary: Removing intent conditioning increases filler retention to 63% and drops interleaved score by 23.1 pp

claims.claim_text_verbatim: ToolBench accuracy falls from 78.7% to 65.7% (Table 4).
claims.claim_summary: Removing prefix consolidation drops ToolBench accuracy from 78.7% to 65.7%

claims.claim_text_verbatim: ALFWorld success remains near perfect, but mean actions increase from 9.62 to 11.74, and episode-start context grows from 19.7k to 50.7k tokens in the inspected stream.
claims.claim_summary: Without prefix consolidation, ALFWorld context size grows to 50.7k tokens and mean actions increase

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Disabling recall on the same post-ingestion MemoryAgentBench 64k snapshot reduces accuracy from 41.0% to 27.0%.
claims.claim_summary: Disabling progressive recall drops 64k MemoryAgentBench accuracy from 41% to 27%

claims.claim_text_verbatim: Inducing a playbook therefore offers no clear advantage here over directly using retained facts and grounded lessons (Table 9).
claims.claim_summary: Explicit playbook induction provides no advantage over direct retention of facts and lessons
